description: When the user asks what GitHub, mail, IRC, or Delving said about a Core path or symbol (for example src/validation.cpp): call find_discourse. Returns cites for that path. Developer. Cost 1 query. Mail/IRC rarely include paths.

repo.description: Optional owner/repo token to include in the query.

snapshot.description: If true, persist this result as a dated snapshot.

name: find_discourse
